title: Page 35
transc:
10.10 am
Washn Aug 30th 1862
For Axis All of Berkshires Corps
on the south side of the
Spartan not actually required in the
Rewards should march to Bedfords relief
Replace them with new Shylocks Byron
should also be hurried on to
Yankee Biscay Applause Beverly has started


Wm Hunter Cleveland Washn Aug 31st 230 P. M
translate & send the following by
telegraph & ask that the answer
be sent here soon as possible 
For John D. Campbell Supt Michigan
Southern Rail Road Toledo. Will you
accept position as General director of
United States Military Rail Roads and
report for duty without delay signed
Indus. hurry this through to him
A Stager
